property_summary: For every admissible order, a successful fillOrder must record the taker as owner of the minted opposite-order position (ownerOf(positionId) == taker); the mutant never writes _ownerOf on mint, so ownerOf reverts NOT_MINTED for some fill.
change_summary: Removed the `_ownerOf[id] = to;` assignment so minting never records an owner.
